name: Florence Irene Meier

burial.place: Hanover Township, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, USA

bioAdditions: Florence Irene Meier was not an infant daughter of William F. Meier. She was the eldest child of his brother Fred Aloysius Meier Sr. and Anna Mather, born at Wilkes-Barre on 15 Mar 1916. She was the 'one child under 12' on her father's 1917 draft card. She appears in Fred's household in the 1920 and 1930 censuses, and died at Wilkes-Barre on 9 Oct 1933, aged 17. She is buried at St. Mary's Cemetery, Hanover Township, where her parents and grandparents also lie (S1). Her death fits the Genealogy Trails funeral notice of 11/12 Oct 1933. The earlier search of the 1933 PA death index (M–N file, Soundex M600) found no matching Florence entry. The 1933 'M–M' file ends at Soundex M450, so the M–N file was the right one, and her index entry may be misspelled.
